name: Get-AutopilotDiagnosticsCommunity
description: A PowerShell diagnostic script for analyzing Windows Autopilot deployments. Provides comprehensive details about Autopilot profile settings, policies, apps, and certificate profiles tracked via Enrollment Status Page, with support for local PC analysis and captured log files.
keywords: why is autopilot taking so long
author: Andrew Taylor

securityCheck.aiSummary: The codebase centers on backup and restore of user data to OneDrive locations, which is typical for admin/device management tooling. No remote script downloads, credential harvesting, explicit hardcoded secrets, or obfuscated commands were detected. Primary security considerations are data governance/privacy due to broad data backup to cloud storage, potential stealth execution via invisible VBScript, and a data restoration bug in the NEWrestore.bat script that could affect Links restoration. Recommend enabling explicit user consent where appropriate, auditing/logging for hidden executions, securing data in transit at rest, and fixing the Links restoration logic to ensure reliable recovery.

noRemoteExecution.reason: IEX with WebClient download in Powershell Scripts/AVD/avd-box-config-generic.ps1 ([lines: 224](https://github.com/andrew-s-taylor/public/blob/main/Powershell Scripts/AVD/avd-box-config-generic.ps1#L224))
